# Owned bounded pair scalar fixture

A public static method owns a recursive Comparable-super-self bound, two direct
formal inputs, an independent boolean input and an opaque integer result.
Source and SDK-provider profiles compile every recovered Java unit and compare
original entries, fields, metadata and Exceptions. Frozen callers run 96 fresh
JVM cases twice through four entry routes. Inputs trap compareTo, equals,
hashCode and toString; observers check nulls, aliases, both flags, arbitrary
integers, callbacks, partial writes and exact failures. Six wrong programs and
six Code-preserving Signature controls protect the bound and complete ABI.
Only owned fixture programs execute. Use JDK 21 and release 8.
